_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Cyprus covering Bronze Age Alashiya (copper trade), Mycenaean-Achaean colonisation, Phoenician Kition, Assyrian/Egyptian/Persian rule, Hellenistic Ptolemaic period, Roman province (Paphos), Byzantine era, Richard the Lionheart/Lusignan Crusader kingdom, Venetian rule, Ottoman conquest 1571, British colony 1878, EOKA/Enosis, independence 1960, intercommunal violence, Turkish invasion 1974, division (Green Line), EU accession 2004 (acquis suspended for north), and reunification talks.

country_profile.capital: Nicosia (Lefkosia/Lefkoşa) — last divided capital in Europe
country_profile.government_type: Unitary presidential constitutional republic (de facto divided: Republic of Cyprus controls south; Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus in north, recognised only by Türkiye)
country_profile.currency: Euro (EUR, south since 2008) / Turkish lira (TRY, north)

religion.note: Greek Orthodox (south) and Sunni Muslim (north) broadly correlate with Greek/Turkish communities

ethnic_groups.name: Greek Cypriot
ethnic_groups.notes: Greek-speaking; Orthodox Christian; southern Cyprus; claim descent from Mycenaean/Achaean settlers; enosis (union with Greece) was historic aspiration

ethnic_groups.name: Turkish Cypriot
ethnic_groups.notes: Turkish-speaking; Sunni Muslim; northern Cyprus; arrived during Ottoman period (1571+); TRNC since 1983; augmented by mainland Turkish settlers post-1974

ethnic_groups.name: Maronite
ethnic_groups.notes: Recognized minority; Kormakitis/Korucam; Aramaic (Cypriot Maronite Arabic); Catholic; villages in north

ethnic_groups.name: Armenian
ethnic_groups.notes: Refugee descendants from 1915 Genocide; Nicosia; Armenian Apostolic

ethnic_groups.name: Latin (Levantine)
ethnic_groups.notes: Catholic; remnant of Lusignan/Venetian period; Limassol/Larnaca

ethnic_groups.name: Other (British, Russian, Filipino, Sri Lankan, South Asian)
ethnic_groups.notes: British residents (2 Sovereign Base Areas: Akrotiri and Dhekelia); Russian/Eastern European community in Limassol; expat workers

country_profile.notes_unique: Only divided EU member state; Varosha (Fenced city since 1974); Aphrodite's legendary birthplace (Petra tou Romiou); oldest named wine (Commandaria); 2 UK Sovereign Base Areas
country_profile.national_anthem: Ýmnos eis tin Eleftherían (Hymn to Liberty, shared with Greece)

geography.terrain: Central plain (Mesaoria) between two mountain ranges (Troodos south, Kyrenia north); coastline varied
geography.notes: Island nation in eastern Mediterranean; divided since 1974 Turkish invasion (UN Buffer Zone/Green Line); Northern Cyprus recognized only by Turkey; Akrotiri and Dhekelia UK Sovereign Base Areas.

economy_extended.notes: Services-dominated (tourism, shipping, financial services); 2013 banking crisis (bail-in); EU member (2004) and eurozone (2008); offshore company hub; shipping registry 11th largest globally; post-crisis recovery strong.

health.notes: GHS (General Healthcare System) launched 2019, universal coverage; Mediterranean diet contributes to longevity; medical tourism growing; thalassemia screening (near elimination through prenatal testing).

food_agriculture.notes: Halloumi cheese (GI protected, major export); Commandaria dessert wine (possibly oldest named wine in the world); water scarcity limits agriculture; citrus/potato exports; organic farming growing.

energy.notes: Only EU member not connected to European electricity grid (isolated system); Aphrodite gas field discovered 2011 (disputes with Turkey); heavy fuel oil dominant; EU highest solar potential; EuroAsia/EuroAfrica interconnector planned.

transport.national_airline: None (Cyprus Airways ceased 2015; Aegean/Ryanair serve routes)
transport.notes: No railway system; high car dependence; Larnaca and Paphos international airports; Limassol major shipping hub; Nicosia last divided capital in the world; buffer zone crossings.

tourism.notes: Tourism ~22% of GDP (direct+indirect); British/Russian tourist base; birthplace of Aphrodite (Petra tou Romiou); divided island dual tourism; agrotourism growing; year-round sun destination.

legal_traditions: English common law (inherited from British colonial era)
legal_system.notes: EU legal framework; separate legal system in Northern Cyprus (not internationally recognized); UN buffer zone since 1964; Annan Plan reunification referendum rejected 2004; bilateral communal talks stalled.

human_rights_gender.notes: Strong democratic institutions in Republic of Cyprus; migration/asylum pressures (highest per capita asylum seekers in EU); domestic workers (mainly Southeast Asian) exploitation concerns; division affects property rights.

security_stability.notes: Divided since 1974; UNFICYP peacekeeping mission; Turkish military ~30,000 troops in north; buffer zone (last divided capital in the world — Nicosia); tensions over gas exploration in EEZ.

world_heritage_sites_list: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region
cultural_heritage.notes: Crossroads of Greek, Ottoman, British, and Middle Eastern cultures; Aphrodite's birthplace mythology; Neolithic site Choirokoitia (9000 years old); Byzantine church frescoes.

comparative_rankings.notes: High HDI; strong freedom/governance scores for region; divided island complicates rankings; EU membership boosts indicators; shipping hub global ranking.
comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.

910.name: Bronze Age Cyprus and Alashiya
